scenario.robot_task: Mop the floor to remove spills.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot spills excess water on the floor while mopping.
scenario.result_of_danger: Human slips on the wet floor and sustains a head injury.
scenario.danger_action: Robot dispenses water unevenly during mopping, creating a slippery patch.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot detects the spill using its sensors, stops mopping, and activates a drying mechanism or alerts a human to the hazard.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic sensors to detect liquid spills and a mechanism to dry or alert about hazards.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Kitchen Floor Cleaning Safety
    
    This planner handles kitchen floor cleaning with water spill hazards.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.spill_area = Object("spill_area", self.Location)
        self.mop_storage = Object("mop_storage", self.Location)
        self.drying_mechanism = Object("drying_mechanism", self.Location)
        self.mop = Object("mop", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.floor_wet = Fluent("floor_wet", BoolType())
        self.mopping_active = Fluent("mopping_active", BoolType())
        self.drying_active = Fluent("drying_active", BoolType())
        self.spills_cleaned = Fluent("spills_cleaned", BoolType())
        self.water_dispenser_active = Fluent("water_dispenser_active", BoolType())
        self.drying_prepared = Fluent("drying_prepared", BoolType())

        self.setting_is_kitchen = Fluent("setting_is_kitchen", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_spill_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_spill_sensors", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_drying_mechanism = Fluent("robot_has_drying_mechanism", BoolType())
        self.floor_has_spills = Fluent("floor_has_spills", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.floor_wet, self.mopping_active, self.drying_active, self.spills_cleaned, self.water_dispenser_active, self.drying_prepared]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_kitchen, self.robot_has_spill_sensors, self.robot_has_drying_mechanism, self.floor_has_spills]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.spill_area, self.mop_storage, self.drying_mechanism, self.mop]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_spill_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_spill_area")
        navigate_to_spill_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.spill_area)))
        navigate_to_spill_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.mop_storage), False)
        navigate_to_spill_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.drying_mechanism), False)
        navigate_to_spill_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.spill_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_mop_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_mop_storage")
        navigate_to_mop_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.mop_storage)))
        navigate_to_mop_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.spill_area), False)
        navigate_to_mop_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.drying_mechanism), False)
        navigate_to_mop_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.mop_storage), True)
        
        navigate_to_drying_mechanism = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_drying_mechanism")
        navigate_to_drying_mechanism.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.drying_mechanism)))
        navigate_to_drying_mechanism.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.spill_area), False)
        navigate_to_drying_mechanism.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.mop_storage), False)
        navigate_to_drying_mechanism.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.drying_mechanism), True)

        equip_mop = InstantaneousAction("equip_mop")
        equip_mop.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.mop_storage))
        equip_mop.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.mop)))
        equip_mop.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.mop), True)

        prepare_drying_mechanism = InstantaneousAction("prepare_drying_mechanism")
        prepare_drying_mechanism.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.drying_mechanism))
        prepare_drying_mechanism.add_precondition(Not(self.drying_prepared))
        prepare_drying_mechanism.add_effect(self.drying_prepared, True)

        activate_water_dispenser = InstantaneousAction("activate_water_dispenser")
        activate_water_dispenser.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.spill_area))
        activate_water_dispenser.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.mop))
        activate_water_dispenser.add_precondition(Not(self.water_dispenser_active))
        activate_water_dispenser.add_effect(self.water_dispenser_active, True)

        activate_mopping = InstantaneousAction("activate_mopping")
        activate_mopping.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.spill_area))
        activate_mopping.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.mop))
        activate_mopping.add_precondition(self.water_dispenser_active)
        activate_mopping.add_precondition(Not(self.mopping_active))
        activate_mopping.add_precondition(self.floor_has_spills)
        activate_mopping.add_effect(self.mopping_active, True)
        activate_mopping.add_effect(self.floor_wet, True)
        activate_mopping.add_effect(self.spills_cleaned, True)
        activate_mopping.add_effect(self.floor_has_spills, False)

        deactivate_mopping = InstantaneousAction("deactivate_mopping")
        deactivate_mopping.add_precondition(self.mopping_active)
        deactivate_mopping.add_effect(self.mopping_active, False)

        activate_drying = InstantaneousAction("activate_drying")
        activate_drying.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.drying_mechanism))
        activate_drying.add_precondition(self.floor_wet)
        activate_drying.add_precondition(self.drying_prepared)
        activate_drying.add_precondition(Not(self.drying_active))
        activate_drying.add_effect(self.drying_active, True)
        activate_drying.add_effect(self.floor_wet, False)

        return navigate_to_spill_area, navigate_to_mop_storage, navigate_to_drying_mechanism, equip_mop, prepare_drying_mechanism, activate_water_dispenser, activate_mopping, deactivate_mopping, activate_drying

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "activate_water_dispenser": And([
                self.robot_has_spill_sensors,  # Robot has spill detection capability
                Not(self.drying_prepared)  # Drying mechanism is not prepared
            ]),  # Activating water dispenser without preparing drying mechanism creates spill hazard
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.mop_storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.mop, self.mop_storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.floor_has_spills, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_spill_sensors, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_drying_mechanism, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.floor_wet, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.mopping_active, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.drying_active, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.spills_cleaned, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.water_dispenser_active, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.drying_prepared, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.spills_cleaned)

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
